tasks.short: Estimate cleanup costs and say the range to the landowner.

steps.what: Take cleanup quantities off the investigation and the plan.

loop.output: Quantity rows: item, unit, amount, area
loop.check: The manager checks each amount against the drawing or the table
loop.stop: One pass; an item with no unit stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Quantities sit in drawings and tables, not one export

steps.what: Price standard cleanup items from the approved rate book.
Judge allowances for unknown ground, access and waste.
State the cleanup cost range to the landowner.
Contractor prices the items the rate book does not hold.

tasks.design: Quantities are taken off the investigation, and standard items are priced from the rate book in the {ERP}. The manager sets allowances and states that cost range. Items the rate book does not hold wait for a contractor quote.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantities were remeasured into a sheet for every estimate, and rates lived in old quotes.
tasks.enabler_now: A rate book can price a known item. An allowance for ground nobody has opened still takes judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding how much to allow for ground the investigation did not reach.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which area will cost more once it is opened.

ambition.what: The manager states a cost range as soon as standard items are priced, and names the allowances still open.

tasks.altitude: Pricing meetings stay. Standard lines take less rebuilding. The manager can refuse to state a range that has no allowance for the unknown ground.

reach.task: Price the build items that sit on top of the cleanup
reach.learn: Which cleanup allowances the build price must not double count

evidence.claim: Standard unit rates can be applied by a rule once the quantity and the rate book line match.
An allowance for untested ground is a judgement, not a rate.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Contractor quotes are not the manager's saving. Boundary: from quantities to a stated cost range. The funding application is a later task.

Structured fields are item, unit, amount, rate and allowance reason. The investigation produces quantities; the rate book produces rates. Fallback: the manager types a quantity the extract leaves blank, and a missing rate stays unpriced.
Configure the rate book in the {ERP} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers rate-book lines when a method is added.
No product in the digest prices remediation. This is configuration of a rate table, not a named estimating suite.
unknowns: Whether a rate book already exists or rates live only in old quotes.
Who owns the rate book, the manager or the contractor.
research_questions: What share of items have a rate already, versus a one-off quote?
How often does the stated range miss the later outturn by more than the allowance?

incremental.description: Add rate-book lines when a cleanup method changes

approvals.approved_version: priced lines plus the allowance note stated in the meeting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: quantities are on drawings and most items need a quote, so the rate book saves little and the meeting stays. High: most items have rates and only the takeoff shrinks. Allowances and the meeting stay. Contractor pricing is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Run a quantitative health risk assessment and sign it before release.

steps.what: Assemble exposure inputs for the quantitative health assessment.
Run the standard dose sums for complete pathways.
Judge which health pathways and assumptions actually apply.
Draft the risk assessment from the pathway judgement only.

loop.input: The pathway judgement and the dose results
loop.output: Assessment text where each number cites a dose row
loop.check: The manager rejects a number that is not in the dose results
loop.stop: One draft; a number with no row is deleted
loop.why_not_simpler: The assessment is prose, and a wrong number here is a harm, not a typo

steps.what: Sign the quantitative risk assessment before it is released.

tasks.design: Exposure inputs are assembled and standard dose sums run in {BI}. The manager judges which pathways apply and edits a draft that cites those rows. The assessment is released only when the manager signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dose sums were rebuilt in a sheet each time, and the pathway choice was buried in the same file.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored formula can sum a complete pathway. Deciding that a pathway is complete cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether a person can actually be exposed, when the map and the ground disagree.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which receptor is real and which is a line on a plan.

ambition.what: Each pathway is marked complete or dropped before the dose sum is treated as a result.

tasks.altitude: Assessments stay on the week. Arithmetic takes less rebuilding. The manager can refuse to sign a number whose pathway was not judged complete.

reach.task: Set which health pathways the organisation will treat as complete
reach.learn: The compliance manager's rule for a pathway that is possible but not current

evidence.claim: A wrong figure in a released assessment is hard to pull back, so each number has to trace to a row.
A drafted review cited sources that were not real when the draft was not checked.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Boundary: from laboratory concentrations and a receptor map to a signed assessment. Medical diagnosis is out of scope.

Structured fields are contaminant, concentration, pathway, receptor and dose. The laboratory and the receptor map produce inputs. Fallback: a blank concentration is not treated as zero; the pathway stays open.
Configure the dose formula in {BI} before custom code. Test it on a known pathway first.
Upkeep of 6 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a formula change when a standard exposure factor is revised.
Harm to people is why the signature stays. National health-risk methods vary; use the method named for this permit.
unknowns: Which exposure factors the permit already names.
Whether a specialist outside the team must sign assessments for this client.
research_questions: What share of pathways are complete on a typical site?
How often does the signed assessment get a question back from the regulator?

incremental.description: Revise exposure factors when the named method changes

approvals.approved_version: draft risk assessment the manager signed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: inputs are incomplete and most pathways are argued, so the dose sum saves little. High: pathways are already known and only the arithmetic shrinks. The pathway judgement and the signature stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design the surface or ground water remediation and issue the plan.

steps.what: Read the ground and surface water remediation constraints.

loop.input: Hydrogeology notes and the permit limits for water
loop.output: Rows for aquifer, depth, limit and discharge point
loop.check: The manager checks each limit against the clause
loop.stop: One pass; a limit with no discharge point stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Water limits are written as clauses tied to a named point

steps.what: Choose the water remediation train for this ground.
Size wells, pumps and discharge for that treatment choice.
Draft the water remediation plan from the sizes and the choice.

loop.input: The treatment choice and the equipment sizes
loop.output: Plan notes that cite a size or a constraint row
loop.check: The manager cuts any note that cites neither
loop.stop: One draft; an uncited note is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The plan must follow the choice just made, which is not a stored form

steps.what: Walk the water plan with the contractor and accept it.
Issue the accepted water remediation plan.

tasks.design: Water limits are listed from the permit. The manager chooses the treatment, and sizes are calculated for that choice. The plan is issued only after the contractor walk accepts that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment choice and pump sizes were argued in the same unmarked document.
tasks.enabler_now: Once a treatment is chosen, well and pump sizes follow from flow and limit. The choice itself does not.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a train that will work in ground the boreholes only partly describe.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which aquifer the boreholes did not reach.

ambition.what: The treatment is chosen before any equipment is sized, so a rejected train is not priced.

tasks.altitude: Design meetings stay. Sizing takes less rework. The manager can stop a plan that sizes equipment for a treatment the walk did not accept.

reach.task: Check that foundations do not cut the water treatment wells
reach.learn: Where wells and pumps must stay clear of the build

evidence.claim: Arithmetic for a chosen flow and a numeric limit is a rules task.
Selecting a water treatment for incomplete ground data stays with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Boundary: from water limits and a walk to an issued plan. Operating the plant later is out of scope.
Structured fields are aquifer, depth, limit, discharge point, flow and pump size. The permit and the manager's treatment choice produce them. Fallback: a missing discharge point blocks sizing.
Configure the sizing sheet before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new discharge limit.
Discharge limits are the permit's, not a limit this design invents.
unknowns: Whether pump curves are already in the rate file.
Whether the contractor or the manager leads the treatment choice.
research_questions: What share of sites have a complete aquifer description before the choice?
How often is the treatment changed after the contractor walk?

incremental.description: Update sizing factors when a discharge limit changes

approvals.approved_version: draft water plan walked with the contractor
accepted water plan from that walk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the aquifer is poorly known, so the choice is remade on site and sizing is redone. High: limits are numeric and only sizing and the draft shrink. The choice and the walk stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose measures for contaminated water, air and soil, then accept a method.

steps.what: Map which contaminated media fail the site standards.
Walk abandoned ground and note access, neighbours and hazards.
Choose measures that fit the failed media and the access.
Contractor proposes a method for the chosen measures.
Accept or reject the method against the site standards.

tasks.design: A {BI} table shows which media fail the standards. The manager walks the ground and chooses measures that fit the access. A contractor method is accepted only against those standards.
tasks.previous_blocker: Media results and access notes were separate, so the method was picked before anyone had listed what failed.
tasks.enabler_now: A certificate can be compared with numeric standards. Choosing a measure on abandoned ground cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Picking a measure that crews can reach without opening a new path for contamination.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees unstable ground and neighbours the table does not show.

ambition.what: Measures are chosen only for media that fail a named standard, and a method is accepted or rejected against that list.

tasks.altitude: Walks stay. The failure table is ready before the walk. The manager can reject a method that does not address a failed medium.

reach.task: Set access controls for hazardous ground
reach.learn: Which access limits apply before a crew opens abandoned ground

evidence.claim: Comparing a certificate with a numeric standard is a rules check.
Choosing a measure on abandoned or unstable ground stays with the person who walked it.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. The contractor's proposal is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from the certificate to a method decision. Military clearance and mine safety licences stay with the people who hold them.
Structured fields are medium, contaminant, result, standard and pass or fail. The laboratory and the constraint list produce them. Fallback: a result with no standard is marked unknown, not pass.
Configure the comparison in {BI} before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a standard added to the list.
This design does not set occupational exposure limits. Those stay with the named site rules.
unknowns: Whether air, water and soil standards are already one list.
Whether military or mine sites in this portfolio add a clearance step this task does not hold.
research_questions: What share of media results are a clear fail versus a value with no standard?
How often is a contractor method rejected after the walk?

incremental.description: Add standards when the permit names a new medium
Contractor still writes the method proposal

approvals.approved_version: method decision against the failure table

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most results have no numeric standard, so the table saves little and the walk decides everything. High: failures are clear and only the table shrinks. The walk and the method decision stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still site walks, crew briefings and hearings. Constraint lists, permit fields and cost lines are ready before the visit. The manager can stop a method, a filing or a price that is not on a checked version.
reach: Construction managers: sequence demolition so contamination is not spread
Compliance managers: say which breaches are notified the same day
Regulatory affairs managers: keep the permit condition list current
skills_to_grow: Checking an extracted constraint against the source line
Reading a laboratory certificate without treating a blank as zero
Holding a filing or a price that is not the checked version
role.ambitious_version: Each site carries a versioned constraint list, each filing uses fields the manager has checked, and each on-site commitment stays inside a limit already signed.

job.title: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
